questions.prompt: The supreme law of India is:
questions.rationale: The Constitution is supreme; other laws must conform to it.

questions.prompt: At the apex of India's judiciary is the:
questions.rationale: The Supreme Court sits at the top of the integrated judiciary.

questions.prompt: Name two essentials of a valid contract under the 1872 Act.
questions.model_answer: Any two of: offer & acceptance, lawful consideration, free consent, capacity, lawful object.
questions.rationale: These are the core ingredients of an enforceable contract.
